words.definition: The method and practice of teaching
words.definationTranslation: Adhyapan ka tareeka aur abhyas

sentence.sentence: The teacher's pedagogy was focused on student-centered learning.
sentence.translation: Adhyapak ki shikshan vidhi vidyarthi-kendra mein adhyayan par kendrit thi.

sentence.sentence: Effective pedagogy is essential for academic success.
sentence.translation: Prabhavi shikshan vidhi shaikshik safalta ke liye avashyak hai.

words.definition: The courses offered by an educational institution
words.definationTranslation: Shikshan sansthan dwara prastut kiye gaye path

sentence.sentence: The school's curriculum includes a wide range of subjects.
sentence.translation: Is school ke pathayakram mein kayi vishay shaamil hain.

sentence.sentence: The curriculum is designed to meet the needs of diverse learners.
sentence.translation: Pathayakram vibhinn adhyetayon ke liye upyukt banaya gaya hai.

words.definition: The evaluation of student learning
words.definationTranslation: Vidyarthi adhyayan ka mulyankan

sentence.sentence: The teacher used various methods of assessment to evaluate student progress.
sentence.translation: Adhyapak ne vidyarthi pragati ka mulyankan karne ke liye kayi tarike upyog kiye.

sentence.sentence: Assessment is an ongoing process throughout the academic year.
sentence.translation: Mulyankan pooray shaikshik varsh ke dauran chalne wala prakriya hai.

words.definition: The principle of fairness and justice in education
words.definationTranslation: Shikshan mein nyay aur samanta ka siddhant

sentence.sentence: The school strives to promote equity and inclusion for all students.
sentence.translation: Is school mein sabhi vidyarthiyon ke liye samanta aur samavesh ko badhava dena prayaas kiya jaata hai.

sentence.sentence: Equity in education is essential for social justice.
sentence.translation: Shikshan mein samanta samajik nyay ke liye avashyak hai.

words.definition: The practice of including diverse groups in education
words.definationTranslation: Shikshan mein vividh samuhon ko shaamil karne ka abhyas

sentence.sentence: The school has an inclusive policy to support students with disabilities.
sentence.translation: Is school ke paas viklang vidyarthiyon ko sahayata ke liye ek samaveshi neeti hai.

sentence.sentence: Inclusion is essential for creating a supportive learning environment.
sentence.translation: Samavesh sahayak adhyayan vatavaran banaane ke liye avashyak hai.

words.definition: The variety of different cultures, backgrounds, and experiences
words.definationTranslation: Alag-alag sanskritiyon, pechhadaon aur anubhavon ki vividhata

sentence.sentence: The school celebrates diversity by promoting cultural events.
sentence.translation: Is school mein saanskritik karyakramon ko badhava dkar vividhata ka utsav manaaya jaata hai.

sentence.sentence: Diversity enriches the learning experience for all students.
sentence.translation: Vividhata sabhi vidyarthiyon ke liye adhyayan anubhav ko samriddh banati hai.

words.definition: The increasing interconnectedness of the world's economies and cultures
words.definationTranslation: Vishva ki arthvyavasthaon aur sanskritiyon ke badhate sambandh

sentence.sentence: Globalization has led to increased international collaboration in education.
sentence.translation: Vishvaikaran ke kaaran shikshan mein antarrashtriya sahyog badha hai.

sentence.sentence: Globalization has created new opportunities for global citizenship.
sentence.translation: Vishvaikaran ne vishv nagrikta ke liye naye avasar paida kiye hain.

words.definition: The application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes
words.definationTranslation: Vyaavahaarik uddeshyon ke liye vaigyanik gyan ka upyog

sentence.sentence: Technology has transformed the way we learn and teach.
sentence.translation: Prudyogiki ne hum kaise seekhte hain aur sikhate hain, us tarah ko badal diya hai.

sentence.sentence: Technology has increased access to education for marginalized communities.
sentence.translation: Prudyogiki ke kaaran vanchit samudayon ke liye shikshan tak pahunch badh gayi hai.

words.definition: The ability to read and write
words.definationTranslation: Padhne aur likhne ki kshamta

sentence.sentence: Literacy is a fundamental right and a key factor in social development.
sentence.translation: Aksharata ek moolbhoot adhikaar hai aur samajik vikas mein ek mahatvapoorn kaarak hai.

sentence.sentence: Literacy programs have improved educational outcomes for disadvantaged groups.
sentence.translation: Aksharata karyakramon ne vanchit vargon ke liye shikshan parinaamon mein sudhar kiya hai.

words.definition: The ability to understand and work with numbers
words.definationTranslation: Sankhyao ko samajhne aur unke saath kaam karne ki kshamta

sentence.sentence: Numeracy skills are essential for everyday life and academic success.
sentence.translation: Ankagaanit kaushal rojmarra ke jeevan aur shaikshik safalta ke liye avashyak hain.

sentence.sentence: Numeracy education should start from an early age.
sentence.translation: Ankagaanit shiksha ko shuruaat se hi dena chahiye.

words.definition: Relating to the duties and responsibilities of citizens
words.definationTranslation: Nagrikon ke kartavyon aur jimmedariyon se sambandhit

sentence.sentence: Civic education is essential for creating responsible citizens.
sentence.translation: Nagrik shiksha jimmedar nagrikon ka nirmaan ke liye avashyak hai.

sentence.sentence: Civic engagement is critical for a healthy democracy.
sentence.translation: Nagrik sahyog swasth loktantra ke liye mahatvapoorn hai.

words.definition: The ability to maintain or support a process without depleting resources
words.definationTranslation: Sansaadhanon ko khatm kiye bina ek prakriya ko banaye rakhne ya uska samarthan karne ki kshamta

sentence.sentence: Sustainability is a key principle in environmental education.
sentence.translation: Sthirata paryavaran shiksha mein ek mahatvapoorn siddhant hai.

sentence.sentence: Sustainable development is essential for the well-being of future generations.
sentence.translation: Sthir vikas aane wali pidhiyon ke kalyan ke liye avashyak hai.

words.definition: The ability to create new and original ideas
words.definationTranslation: Naye aur mool ideas ko banane ki kshamta

sentence.sentence: Creativity is essential for innovation and progress.
sentence.translation: Rachnatmakta navachar aur pragati ke liye avashyak hai.

sentence.sentence: Creativity can be developed through art, music, and other activities.
sentence.translation: Rachnatmakta kalaa, sangeet aur anya gatividhiyon ke madhyam se viksit ki ja sakti hai.

words.definition: Involving or exercising careful judgment and evaluation
words.definationTranslation: Savdhani se nirnay aur mulyankan ka abhyas

sentence.sentence: Critical thinking is essential for academic success and professional development.
sentence.translation: Vimarshal soch shaikshik safalta aur peshewar vikas ke liye avashyak hai.

sentence.sentence: Critical literacy is necessary for evaluating information in the digital age.
sentence.translation: Digital yug mein suchna ka mulyankan ke liye vimarshal aksharata avashyak hai.

words.definition: The act of working together to achieve a common goal
words.definationTranslation: Ek saamanya lakshya ko prapt karne ke liye milkar kaam karna

sentence.sentence: Collaboration is essential for teamwork and problem-solving.
sentence.translation: Sahyog team work aur samasya samadhan ke liye avashyak hai.

sentence.sentence: Collaboration can lead to more innovative and effective solutions.
sentence.translation: Sahyog adhik navachar aur prabhavi samadhanon ki ore le ja sakta hai.

words.definition: The ability to understand and share the feelings of others
words.definationTranslation: Doosron ke bhavnaon ko samajhne aur unke saath baantne ki kshamta

sentence.sentence: Empathy is essential for building strong relationships and community.
sentence.translation: Saheed majboot sambandh aur samuday banane ke liye avashyak hai.

sentence.sentence: Empathy can help to create a more inclusive and supportive learning environment.
sentence.translation: Saheed ek adhik samaveshi aur sahayak adhyayan vatavaran banane mein madad kar sakta hai.

words.definition: The ability to withstand or recover from difficult situations
words.definationTranslation: Kathin sthitiyon se sahne ya punaruddhar karne ki kshamta

sentence.sentence: Resilience is essential for coping with stress and adversity.
sentence.translation: Samarthan tanav aur vividhata se nipatne ke liye avashyak hai.

sentence.sentence: Resilience can be developed through practice, patience, and persistence.
sentence.translation: Samarthan abhyas, dhairya aur dridhata ke madhyam se viksit ki ja sakti hai.

words.definition: The ability to adjust to new or changing situations
words.definationTranslation: Naye ya badal rahe sthitiyon ke anusaar samayojan karne ki kshamta

sentence.sentence: Adaptability is essential for success in a rapidly changing world.
sentence.translation: Anurodhata tezi se badal rahe vishva mein safalta ke liye avashyak hai.

sentence.sentence: Adaptability can help individuals to thrive in uncertain environments.
sentence.translation: Anurodhata vyaktiyon ko anishchit vatavaranon mein pragati karne mein madad kar sakti hai.

words.definition: The state of being responsible for one's actions
words.definationTranslation: Apane karyaon ke liye jimmewar hona

sentence.sentence: Accountability is essential for maintaining trust and integrity.
sentence.translation: Javabdehi vishwas aur satya-nishtha banaye rakhne ke liye avashyak hai.

sentence.sentence: Accountability can help to promote transparency and fairness.
sentence.translation: Javabdehi paardarshita aur nyay ko badhava de sakti hai.

words.definition: The state of being self-governing and independent
words.definationTranslation: Swayam se shasan aur swatantr hona

sentence.sentence: Autonomy is essential for promoting learner agency and motivation.
sentence.translation: Svatantrata adhyetayi kaary aur prerana ko badhava dene ke liye avashyak hai.

sentence.sentence: Autonomy can help individuals to develop a sense of self-directed learning.
sentence.translation: Svatantrata vyaktiyon ko swayam-nirdeshit adhyayan ka bhav viksit karne mein madad kar sakti hai.

words.definition: The act of taking part in an activity or process
words.definationTranslation: Kisi gatividhi ya prakriya mein bhag lena

sentence.sentence: Participation is essential for creating a sense of community and belonging.
sentence.translation: Bhagidari samuday aur sambandh ka bhav banane ke liye avashyak hai.

sentence.sentence: Participation can help to promote social inclusion and active citizenship.
sentence.translation: Bhagidari samajik samavesh aur sakriya nagrikta ko badhava de sakti hai.

words.definition: The act of thinking carefully about something
words.definationTranslation: Kisi cheez ke baare mein savdhani se vichar karna

sentence.sentence: Reflection is essential for learning and personal growth.
sentence.translation: Aatmachintan adhyayan aur vyaktigat vriddhi ke liye avashyak hai.

sentence.sentence: Reflection can help individuals to develop a sense of self-awareness and introspection.
sentence.translation: Aatmachintan vyaktiyon ko swayam-jagrukta aur antar-darshan viksit karne mein madad kar sakta hai.

words.definition: A conversation between two or more people
words.definationTranslation: Do ya do se adhik logon ke beech sanvaad

sentence.sentence: Dialogue is essential for building relationships and resolving conflicts.
sentence.translation: Sanvaad sambandh banane aur sangharshon ka samadhan karne ke liye avashyak hai.

sentence.sentence: Dialogue can help to promote mutual understanding and respect.
sentence.translation: Sanvaad paraspar samajh aur sammaan ko badhava de sakta hai.

words.definition: The process of cultural change and psychological change that results following meeting between cultures
words.definationTranslation: दो संस्कृतियों के मिलन के परिणामस्वरूप सांस्कृतिक परिवर्तन और मानसिक परिवर्तन की प्रक्रिया

sentence.sentence: The acculturation of immigrant students is a major challenge for educators.
sentence.translation: प्रवासी छात्रों का सांस्कृतिक समायोजन शिक्षकों के लिए एक बड़ी चुनौती है।

sentence.sentence: The school's acculturation program helped new students adjust to the local culture.
sentence.translation: स्कूल के सांस्कृतिक समायोजन कार्यक्रम ने नए छात्रों को स्थानीय संस्कृति के साथ समायोजित करने में मदद की।

words.definition: The state of being diverse or composed of different kinds of things
words.definationTranslation: विभिन्न प्रकार की चीजों से बना होने या विविध होने की स्थिति

sentence.sentence: The heterogeneity of the student body is a strength of the school.
sentence.translation: विद्यार्थी निकाय की विविधता स्कूल की ताकत है।

sentence.sentence: The teacher struggled to create lessons that accounted for the heterogeneity of her classroom.
sentence.translation: शिक्षक को अपनी कक्षा की विविधता को ध्यान में रखते हुए पाठ बनाने में कठिनाई हुई।
